# Ibukunoluwa Oyeniyi

> Full-stack, mobile and AI engineer in Lagos, Nigeria. Developer II and frontend lead at Babban Gona (Developer of the Year), Software Engineering & AI Evaluation Expert at AfterQuery, founder of Master Anything. Email: ibukun46@gmail.com

Claims below are drawn from a public evidence file:

## Current roles
- Babban Gona, Jan 2023 to present. Technical Accelerator intern, then Associate Developer (Aug 2023), Developer I (Feb 2025), Developer II (Jul 2025). Developer of the Year in second year, for delivery impact, engineering quality and consistent ownership across critical products. Leads a frontend team of about five engineers. Owns the AgricOS multi-tenant configuration platform, used by 10,000+ people across Nigeria.
- AfterQuery Experts, 2026 to present. Software Engineering & AI Evaluation Expert (contract). Designs tasks that measure frontier coding agents.
- Master Anything, 2026 to present. Founder and product engineer of an AI learning platform. https://masteranything.app

## Evidence
- Performance: cut median request latency in Program Config Service from 13.7 s to 45.5 ms (about 300x) on a controlled 20,000-record benchmark, through pagination and query/index optimization with backend engineers.
- Delivery: designed and shipped an export service in under one week: frontend integration, PostgreSQL-backed async jobs, recoverable workers, streamed CSV, tenant-scoped permissions, private downloads.
- Quality: ESLint warning backlog 79 to 0; changed-line quality gates; coverage-artifact validation.
- Data: Odoo integrations synchronizing tens of millions of records. 20+ projects and workstreams delivered.
- AI evaluation, AfterQuery Project Gold: 14 repository tasks authored; 3 approved and 11 advanced to human review; 0 rejections in the cycle.
- AI evaluation, Project Pluto: 18 terminal-agent task packages advanced to Ready for Review (Python, Rust, Java), with deterministic integration suites, oracle/no-op separation and multi-model difficulty calibration.
- Security, Project Fenrir: 3 approved paid findings from sanitizer-backed fuzzing, including a cross-call heap use-after-free in a Rust archive pipeline.
- AI adoption: leads AI-assisted engineering across multiple Babban Gona teams: tool selection per task, reusable repository context, validation so AI-written work is checkable.
- Problem solving: 573 LeetCode problems solved (196 easy, 308 medium, 69 hard). In 2022: 905 submissions on 346 days, 65-day max streak. 365-day and 500-day badges. https://leetcode.com/ibkay998
